nonBoundaryRelationMembers.reason: Relation 6474878 (Zona extraterritoriale della Santa Sede, Q114347595) is the Holy See's extraterritorial properties in Italy (Lateran Treaties): boundary=administrative without admin_level and without any ISO3166-1 tag, 53 outer ways in Italian territory, not part of the country's own ring. Relation 36989 lists it with role part (version 117, 2026-07-31); its 9 ring ways already assemble the whole of Vatican City, and the assembled rings are still proved segment for segment. Reviewed 2026-10-13 against the OSM API (version 53, 2026-07-03T20:00:30Z) for the europe/italy/centro-261011 snapshot.
